schema.title: IUIDocument
schema.description: The project-defined iui/1 wire contract. Semantic validation additionally enforces safe expressions, data and URLs. Native nodes are recognized but unsupported by the portable renderer.

contracts.text:
## 状态与表达式

`state` 保存字符串、有限数值或布尔值。引用写作 `{ "$": "gain" }`，计算写作 `{ "op": "mul", "args": [12, { "$": "gain" }] }`。

可用操作符：`add`、`sub`、`mul`、`div`、`max`、`min`、`round`、`abs`、`clamp`、`gt`、`lt`、`eq`、`if`、`format`。它们是受约束的数据树，不是 JavaScript 源码。未知引用、循环依赖、非法参数、除零及非有限结果会被拒绝。

需要直接求值时，可从主入口导入 `evaluateValue` 和 `evaluateState`；通常由控件与渲染器自动处理即可。

# API and security model

`iui/1` is data, never executable source. Content text is inserted through text nodes. The only HTML sink is KaTeX's generated visual HTML plus accessible MathML with `trust:false`, bounded expansion/size, and strict parsing; model HTML never enters that sink directly. Unsupported TeX falls back to visible source.

## Validation

The JSON Schema is generated from `scripts/generate-schema.mjs`. TypeScript declarations and the Ajv standalone validator are generated in the same step. CI rejects drift. Browser code imports the already generated validator, avoiding runtime `new Function` and allowing a script hash CSP without `unsafe-eval`.

`validateDocument(input)` returns `{ok:true,document}` or `{ok:false,issues}`. It accepts plain JSON values only; custom prototypes, accessors, cyclic objects, reserved keys, nonfinite numbers, and excessive values/text/depth are rejected before Ajv traversal. Semantics additionally reject unknown references, computed cycles, bad operator arities/types, numerical errors, duplicate IDs, unknown state bindings, broken topology endpoints, malformed table widths, invalid chart data, and unsafe resource declarations.

`evaluateValue(value,state,computed)` evaluates a constrained expression and throws on invalid input. `evaluateState(document,override)` returns validated, frozen state/computed results or issues. Controller state updates use this checked path. Numeric operators do not coerce strings. `if` is lazy at evaluation but both branches are inspected for references and types; runtime arithmetic errors still reject the state transition.

Limits include 64 JSON nesting levels, 2,000 node-like objects, 50,000 values, a two-million-UTF-16-code-unit text budget (including JSON keys, retained across merged state updates), and schema-specific row/series/child limits. These limits reduce resource exhaustion; they are not a promise of fixed latency for every valid document.

## Browser boundary

No raw HTML, CSS, JS, callback, import, network action, form submission, or arbitrary AppBlock is accepted. SVG uses a fixed shape list and numeric/color/geometry attribute allowlists. `native` is recognized solely to report `UNSUPPORTED_NATIVE`. It does not load an adapter.

Model URLs are limited to the documented link/image policy. Remote images require a reader action and use no-referrer. URLs still lead to third parties when a reader activates them; validation does not certify the destination's content or privacy. Callers handling confidential documents should avoid remote URLs altogether.

Compiled inline HTML applies a CSP containing the exact SHA-256 of its runtime. It blocks network connections, objects, forms, base URL changes, and remote scripts/fonts; font-src data: permits the bundled official WOFF2 fonts. Styles allow inline rules because the renderer writes bounded, host-owned numeric/enum properties. The host browser's CSP remains authoritative for `mount`; pass `styles:false` and serve the stylesheet when embedding under a stricter host policy.

`compileHtml(input,{assets:'inline',backend:'portable',lang})` emits one self-contained HTML file. `compileArtifact(input,{assets:'shared',assetBase:'./iui-assets/',lang})` also returns an asset map with safe relative file paths. Shared output is intended for a static HTTP server; no claim is made for every browser's file-origin shared-script policy. Both reject unsupported backends.

## Lifecycle and scope

Controllers isolate state. `update` validates the complete next document and resets state. `setState` merges a scalar patch, verifies all bindings and derived values, then updates existing nodes without replacing focused controls. `dispose` is idempotent and removes its owned elements, listeners, and resize observer. External DOM edits by the embedding host are outside this contract.

The library does not authenticate users, persist documents, store credentials, run simulations as scientific truth, fetch sources, or verify model-generated facts. Applications remain responsible for provenance, permissions, and their host threat model.

JSON Schema string `maxLength` and evaluated Value/state string maxima use Unicode code points. A Value string accepts at most 12,000 code points, including astral characters, while the independent whole-document resource budget still counts UTF-16 storage units. The resolved evaluation context (state, computed scalars and the evaluated Value) is checked against the same storage budget before DOM creation or refresh; accepted documents therefore do not defer that rejection until rendering. Native form minLength/maxLength constraints retain HTML UTF-16 semantics; they do not redefine the global string contract.

# 天气视图：数据由调用方提供

`weather` 是独立的领域组件，提供地点、更新时间、当前观测、逐日预报、逐小时曲线/数据表。℃/℉、日期、温度/降水概率及图表/表格切换都在本地完成，不查询天气服务，也不自动刷新。

完整原创例子：[weather.json](../examples/weather.json)。它刻意使用合成数据覆盖跨日与夏令时，不能当成实时天气预报。

| 字段 | 约定 |
| --- | --- |
| `location` | `{ name, timezone }`，时区为有效 IANA 名称 |
| `updatedAt` | 这批数据的更新时间，ISO 时间且带 `Z` 或明确偏移 |
| `source` | `{ label, synthetic, url? }`，明确数据来源和是否合成 |
| `units.temperature` | 原始数据单位：`celsius` 或 `fahrenheit`；切换始终从原值换算 |
| `current` | 观测 `time`、`temperature`、`condition`；可选 `feelsLike` 与 `humidity` |
| `daily` | 当地日历 `date`、`low`、`high`、`condition`、`precipitationProbability` |
| `hourly` | 带时区偏移的 `time`、`temperature`、`precipitationProbability` |
| `status` / `message` | `ready` 默认、`loading`、`error` 与可选状态说明 |
| `initialDate` | 可选，必须是提供的逐日日期之一 |

温度、湿度或降水概率未知时用 `null`；湿度与降水概率单位为百分比 `0–100`，`0` 不代表缺测。日期必须递增且不重复；逐小时顺序根据真实时间，而不是本地时钟文字。夏令时出现两次 `01:00` 时，数据表和读数保留各自偏移。

## 完整语义校验：温度与文字

结构 Schema 通过并不表示这些跨字段规则已经通过。挂载或编译前仍须使用完整 `validateDocument`：

- 每个 `daily[]` 条目在 `low`、`high` 都非 `null` 时必须满足 `low <= high`；允许二者相等。任一为 `null` 时不比较大小，也不推算缺测值。
- `current.temperature`、可选的 `current.feelsLike`、`daily[].low/high`、`hourly[].temperature` 的已提供数值，按 `units.temperature` 的源单位校验：摄氏闭区间 `[-273.15, 1000]`，华氏闭区间 `[-459.67, 1000]`。边界可取，`null` 表示缺测；可选字段可以省略。上限 1000 是本库显示输入边界，并不表示该值适合作为实际天气观测。切换显示温标不改变源数据的合法区间。
- 增量展示和请求文字如被提供，不得全为空白（`trim()` 后必须非空）：顶层 `regionLabel/tableDateLabel/resetLabel/requestedLabel/cancelledLabel`、`labels` 的每个值；`current.description`、`daily[].label/description`、`hourly[].label/description`；所有温度文字对象中的 `celsius/fahrenheit/a11yCelsius/a11yFahrenheit`；`share.label`、`locationAction.label/query`；顶层与逐日 `followUps[]` 中的 `id/label/query`。空白无效不会被自动替换为默认值。该要求只覆盖上述明确列出的增量字段，不将旧 `message: ""` 等原有合法输入收紧。

例如，源摄氏温度 `-274` 或 `1001`、逐日 `low: 10, high: 5`、`share.label: " "` 可通过结构检查，却会分别被完整语义检查以 `WEATHER_RANGE` 或 `WEATHER_SUPPLIED_DATA` 拒绝。该区别同样适用于按需生成的分类 Schema。

状态测试文档见 [weather/states.json](../examples/weather/states.json)。它们可直接作为后续统一组件 Demo 的可编辑 JSON 输入。旧固定CDN只支持其对应Schema；新固定入口与本页合同一起列于cdn.md，真实加载验收由该提交的CI记录。

## 可选供数展示与本地意图

原有必填快照字段、默认当前观测标题、默认摄氏/华氏来源单位、图表默认展示，以及 `weatherTemperature`、`weatherHours`、`weatherCoordinates` 三个 helper 的接口均保留。以下字段只做增量扩展；旧 JSON 无需迁移。`loading` / `error` 仍需要原快照结构，缺少快照时由父层提供等待或错误展示。

- `presentation`: `chart`（默认）、`table`、`compact`。紧凑模式展示供数摘要与来源，不提供交互入口。
- `initialUnit`、`initialMetric`: 初始显示温标与 `temperature` / `precipitation`；转换始终使用原始数值，不连续换算已显示文字。
- `useCurrent`: 初始摘要使用当前观测还是所选日期高低温。显式提供后，选择当前当地日期会显示当前观测，选择其它日期显示那一天的预报。省略时保留旧版始终显示当前观测的行为。
- `showDatePicker: false`: 隐藏日期栏，保留其他本地控件。
- `chartWindow: { points, startTime? }`: 1–48 个连续供数时刻；起始时间必须标识供数中的真实瞬间。所选日期与起点同日时从起点开始，否则从所选日期第一时刻开始。窗口可以跨午夜；数据表仍完整展示所选当地日期。省略时保留旧版整日曲线。位置按实际经过的时间计算，缺测断线、零值、夏令时重复时刻保持可辨。
- `current.description`、`daily[].label/description`、`hourly[].label/description/condition`: 直接提供展示文字及逐小时天气状况。存在逐小时描述或状况时，表格增加天气列。
- `current.temperatureLabels`、`hourly[].temperatureLabels`、`daily[].highLabels/lowLabels`: `{ celsius, fahrenheit, a11yCelsius?, a11yFahrenheit? }`。两种温标的文字均由调用方提供，作为完整展示文字，不再自动添加单位；图形几何仍只由数值决定。
- `labels`: 可覆盖 `current/hourly/daily/temperature/precipitation/conditions/time/unit/metric/view/high/low/observation/selected/chartView/tableView/missing/source/updated`。`regionLabel`、`tableDateLabel` 分别覆盖区域名与表格标题；中英文缺省文字跟随宿主语言。
- `disabled`: 禁止本地控件；`resetLabel`、`requestedLabel`、`cancelledLabel` 可覆盖重置按钮和本地请求回执。

`share: { label, available?, placement? }` 显示顶部（默认）或 `bottom` 分享入口。`locationAction: { label, available?, query? }` 显示位置请求入口。两者必须明确 `available: true` 才能触发。组件不会查询天气、获取位置、调用系统分享、写剪贴板、访问账户或记录分析事件。这里的能力字段仅允许发出本地意图，不表示已得到浏览器权限或外部服务结果。

`followUps` 以及 `daily[].followUps` 接受最多 12 个 `{ id, label, query, disabled? }`；同一组 ID 不重复。初始显示顶层问题，选择日期后显示该日问题，无该日问题时不保留旧日问题。每组只展示前三项，区域宽度低于 576px / 380px 时分别显示两项 / 一项，隐藏项不会触发请求。

三个入口统一发出 `iui:weather-action`，事件会冒泡、可取消、不跨 shadow boundary；冻结的 `detail` 包含 `id`、`intent`（`share` / `request-location` / `follow-up`）、所选 `date`、显示 `unit` 与 `metric`。位置请求可带供数 `query`；问题请求带 `actionId` 与 `query`。`preventDefault()` 会显示取消回执；接受只表示宿主接受本地请求，不宣称分享、定位或查询已经成功。

项目提供可见的本地 “Reset weather view” 按钮。它恢复初始日期、单位、指标、视图、摘要模式和问题组并清空回执，也作为原生 `form.reset()` 的稳定可见锚点。原生重置被取消时保留当前选择；稍后输入优先于待定重置。禁用、隐藏、inert、脱离原归属或已销毁的控件不能执行操作。`update` 建立新的供数视图，旧事件及待定重置不能覆盖新视图。

域源码验证见 `tests/weather-supplied.test.mjs`；原 `tests/weather.test.mjs` 继续覆盖旧接口、数值与时区。`tests/browser/weather-supplied.spec.mjs` 提供原生键盘、重置、响应式及零外部能力回归，需在允许启动浏览器的环境实际执行；测试发现列表不等同于浏览器通过记录。

The integrated keyboard follow-up filters Ctrl/Alt/Meta/Shift, composition and legacy keyCode229 inside the existing guarded admission for both date tabs and chart navigation. Original modifier/IME failures remain recorded; ordinary arrows/Home/End are unchanged.

## Source and literal text

`FinanceSource` requires `label` and `synthetic`; `url` is optional. The literal `synthetic` flag describes the supplied source, not a verified provenance claim. A nonempty URL must pass the existing safe-link policy (`UNSAFE_URL`). Omitted URL and the empty string are valid; a whitespace URL is not. There is no blanket `trim()` rule on finance display strings: schema-valid whitespace-only titles, source labels, names, symbols, range labels, sector, weightLabel, changeBasis and messages retain their existing behavior. Time zones and timestamps have the specific checks below. Do not impose the stricter label rules of later ledger display families here.

Prices, previous closes and heatmap weights are nonnegative finite numbers or explicit null. Zero is known data; null means missing. Currency is the existing three-capital-letter pattern, not a currency registry or conversion request. Optional component `id` remains a document-wide node identifier; record IDs have the collection scopes below. No new ID normalization or pattern tightening is introduced. In particular, legacy finance currency/record-key patterns retain their existing end-anchor behavior; the stricter exact-end currency/supplied-key patterns of later ledger records are not substituted here.

# Supplied finance snapshot source contract

This is the mandatory semantic contract for `finance/snapshots` and its source helper. These are the existing `finance-quote`, `finance-chart`, `finance-comparison` and `finance-heatmap` nodes. Source migration adds no market service, trade, financial recommendation or rule. Examples are original synthetic data. Run full `validateDocument` after selected structural validation; loading/error presentations do not bypass validation of supplied records.

## Source and literal text

`FinanceSource` requires `label` and `synthetic`; `url` is optional. The literal `synthetic` flag describes the supplied source, not a verified provenance claim. A nonempty URL must pass the existing safe-link policy (`UNSAFE_URL`). Omitted URL and the empty string are valid; a whitespace URL is not. There is no blanket `trim()` rule on finance display strings: schema-valid whitespace-only titles, source labels, names, symbols, range labels, sector, weightLabel, changeBasis and messages retain their existing behavior. Time zones and timestamps have the specific checks below. Do not impose the stricter label rules of later ledger display families here.

Prices, previous closes and heatmap weights are nonnegative finite numbers or explicit null. Zero is known data; null means missing. Currency is the existing three-capital-letter pattern, not a currency registry or conversion request. Optional component `id` remains a document-wide node identifier; record IDs have the collection scopes below. No new ID normalization or pattern tightening is introduced. In particular, legacy finance currency/record-key patterns retain their existing end-anchor behavior; the stricter exact-end currency/supplied-key patterns of later ledger records are not substituted here.

## Instruments, history and comparison

Instrument time zones, and optional comparison timezone, must be recognized by `Intl.DateTimeFormat` (`TIMEZONE`). Snapshot `asOf`, history `time`, comparison `baselineAt`, and range endpoints must have real Gregorian dates and a parseable explicit-offset timestamp under the existing timestamp parser (`FINANCE_DATE`, `FINANCE_ORDER`, `FINANCE_RANGE`). This is distinct from the minute-only `flightAt` contract used by later ledger records.

History has at most 500 points. Compare actual offset-adjusted instants: history is strictly increasing and unique, with no point after its instrument's `asOf`. Equal wall labels with different offsets are not necessarily equal instants. Instrument IDs are unique within the 2–6 instrument comparison, and range IDs are unique within their list (`FINANCE_ID`). Each range includes its endpoints, may have equal endpoints, and must have from <= to. `initialRange` must name a supplied range (`FINANCE_RANGE`). Empty ranges select the supplied observations without fetching more.

A comparison normalizes only against a positive supplied history price at exactly `baselineAt`. Missing, null or zero baselines remain valid but incomparable; never substitute a nearby observation. Equal offset-adjusted instants match. The baseline need not lie within the displayed range or be present in every series. A known positive previous close is required for a quote's percentage change. Derived quote and normalization percentages must stay finite (`FINANCE_VALUE`). Different currencies are not converted or placed on a common absolute-price axis.

Market status and delay are literal source declarations. No clock-driven market-status inference or real-time guarantee follows from zero declared delay. Null observations split lines. Range/series selection and cursor inspection are local; hiding a series does not remove supplied table records. An update replaces the snapshot; disposal retires its controls. These source modules do not alter that runtime.

## Heatmap

Overall timezone and `asOf` must be valid. Every cell has a unique ID (`FINANCE_ID`), valid snapshot instant no later than the overall `asOf` (`FINANCE_DATE`), and required source-declared status/delay. `initialSector` must exactly match a supplied cell sector (`FINANCE_FILTER`), including when status is loading/error.

Area uses positive known weights supplied in a common unit, not price or an inferred exchange rate. Zero/null or too-small-to-draw weights receive no fabricated area; all records remain in the table. Color uses the supplied finite `changePercent` or null, independently of weight and price. Saturation at ±10% does not change the displayed original value. Missing change and zero are neutral but distinct values. Sector filtering, keyboard inspection and table expansion are local only.

The [finance behavior guide](finance.md) and [heatmap guide](heatmap.md) provide presentation/history context. Those links do not enlarge the mandatory semantic reading set or claim a new browser, CDN or visual acceptance run.

# Supplied lookup demonstrations

`conversational-onboarding-search` provides three real, local presentations: a Weather snapshot, a financial chart and finite news summaries with source cards. This is an original implementation of observable tab, snapshot and card behavior. Captured code, assets, analytics and external lookup services are not included.

Resolved data requires `weather`, `stock` and `news`, each with a visible `label` and `question`. Weather accepts an actual `WeatherNode` in `snapshot`, preserving required snapshot fields, timezone checks, known-zero/missing distinctions and the additive chart/table/compact controls. Stock accepts an actual `FinanceChartNode`, including its explicit instrument, source and ranges, with chronological and range semantics checked. Parent presentation hides Weather sharing just as the observed search demonstration did. No provider is contacted.

News takes up to 50 `{text,sourceId}` summaries and 30 distinct source items `{id,title,url,sourceLabel,dateLabel?,imageSrc?,faviconSrc?}`. Every citation references a supplied item. Summary citation buttons and source cards emit frozen, cancelable, bubbling, non-composed `iui:search-open` with `{id,itemId,url}`. Accepting the request does not navigate, write a clipboard or fetch a page. A stock provenance link is also intercepted into the same local request. The news picture area and text button both support opening the same supplied item.

Images use the shared owned SearchImage renderer. Inline raster images can display immediately. An HTTP(S) image requires explicit activation of the local image-load control before assigning its source; loading an image does not open its news link. Supplied favicon images or a local source initial provide fallbacks. Switching views or updating retires child media and clears old image sources.

News uses the existing finite Carousel mechanism. Cards occupy 47.5% of a narrow component and 31.5% at a 576px component width, with a 144px media area. This is a component container breakpoint, not a viewport estimate. The carousel owns its existing frame and observer lifecycle.

Tabs support normal pointer and keyboard activation, roving focus, RTL arrows and Home/End; modified or composing keys do not switch tabs. `iui:onboarding-tab` retains the shared local cancelable receipt. Selecting another tab remounts that presentation, matching the observed conditional content. Native form reset restores the original tab and embedded state. Canceled resets and newer user input take priority. Disabled, hidden, inert, first-legend, generation and owner constraints remain active.

Pending uses a 140px local loading presentation; failed uses explicit fallback text or hides the component. Empty news remains explicitly empty. No generated search results, live stock prices, current weather or completed external actions are invented.

Source-build tests include actual standalone compilation. Native browser tests are supplied separately; discovery alone does not establish browser or reference-pixel acceptance. The frozen CDN still belongs to unified164 until a later unified asset build.

Local integration follow-up: carousel resource notifications (resize, scroll, media/font lifecycle) do not enter the user-input gate or change the reset revision. The parent observes actual nested Weather date/readout changes for keyboard and pointer input, so a later embedded interaction supersedes a queued parent reset. Original keyboard-reset and Window-as-Node failures are retained;15 domain checks and the original10 independent checks passed on the correction.

## Required source-package validation

`SEARCH_TEXT` checks node label; each supplied weather/stock/news label and question; news item id/title/sourceLabel; each summary text. News IDs are unique (`SEARCH_ID`) and summary sourceId must refer to a supplied item (`SEARCH_SOURCE`). News URL/imageSrc/faviconSrc use core link/image safety when present. Other strings retain structural constraints without blanket trim. Weather child runs extension and supplied-text checks plus source safety; stock runs full Finance checks. The explicit required Weather and Finance contracts are part of this package. Supplied child data is validated even when pending/failed; no live lookup occurs.
